items.text: Voted for a budget law that reduced funding for public health coverage for low-income residents, added work requirements to that coverage, and reduced food assistance.
Voted against a three-year extension of expanded premium subsidies for individually purchased health insurance.
Voted for a bill that loosened rules for employer and association health plans and did not extend the expiring premium subsidies.
Voted for a funding bill that did not extend the expiring premium subsidies.

Said the budget law protects public health coverage for pregnant women, children, older people, and people with disabilities, requires work from able-bodied adults, and discourages regional governments from expanding coverage.
